notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). Constructor arguments are $poolManager then $token; the mainnet PoolManager is 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90. Deploy SIMDTESTHook directly at a CREATE2-mined address whose low 14 bits equal 0x20cc. The hook constructor deploys its immutable SIMDTESTRouter, exposed as rewardRouter; the router is not a wrapper around the declared hook. beforeInitialize accepts the SIMDTEST/IMD pair with fee 12500 and tickSpacing 60. All enabled callbacks accept only PoolManager calls. Constants are buyerRewardFeeBps=200, minBuyUnits=10e18 and poolFeeBps=12500; the last value uses v4 millionths and means a static 1.25% LP fee. The 2% IMD hook fee is additional, collected through beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas without an LP fee override. Qualifying buys must use rewardRouter, which makes the caller both payer and recipient. Rewards equal floor(actual IMD spent including the hook fee / 100) when spent >=10e18; sells and swaps through other routers earn no rewards. Other routers still pay the hook fee. Partial fills cap fees using a reverting PoolManager preview. Exact-input buys include the hook fee in their input budget; exact-output sells specify net IMD received. Fees accrue to the hook as IMD, falling back to PoolManager ERC-6909 claims if an immediate transfer fails. Anyone can call collectFees to redeem those claims to the hook. pending(buyer) and owedTotal expose recorded reward debt. claimRewards pays the caller; permissionless payRecorded(buyer) pays only that beneficiary. Payments are forbidden while PoolManager is unlocked, including during swap callbacks; claims are redeemed automatically if a reward payment needs them. Surplus fees remain in the hook. There is no owner, admin, setter, proxy or upgrade mechanism. SIMDTEST is a standard ERC20 with a zero-argument constructor, no transfer tax and a single full-supply mint to its deployer. Allocation is external launch policy. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 provenance only; the launch factory sets the opening price from the economics.
